An openwork lace blouse built from a large-scale scalloped fan motif with sizable pierced oval and circular cutouts arranged in radiating panels across the body; the cutwork is dense enough that the skin reads through the open ground over the torso and down the sleeves. A separate small ring-and-loop crochet-like trim edges the round neckline, and the lower body terminates in a pronounced scalloped, pointed-tab hem rather than a straight edge. The elbow-length sleeves end in a narrow banded cuff gathered slightly, and the same openwork cutting continues through the sleeve body.

Western-style snap-front shirt with pointed yokes front and back and two flap-closed chest pockets whose flaps follow a sawtooth/western point; the pattern is a dense vertical arrangement of narrow woven stripes interspersed with small square dot motifs running the full length of the body and sleeves, and the snap placket sits on a center front opening between the collar points and the hem.

A large rectangular photographic graphic dominates the center-front chest-to-lower-torso area: a dusk-toned stage photograph of a band performing amid lit evergreen trees, set below an arched 'NIRVANA' wordmark rendered in a red-to-yellow vertical gradient. The graphic block sits as a single contained panel rather than bleeding to the garment edges, with the faded black body cloth framing it on all sides. Overlock/coverstitch topstitching is visible along the shoulder and sleeve seams, reading as exposed contrast stitching against the washed-black ground.

Fine-gauge smooth knit short-sleeve polo with an open (buttonless) placketless V-neck where the collar stands away in a soft Johnny-collar manner, the two collar leaves parting into a shallow V at centre front. A thin white tipping line traces the collar edge and continues down both sides of the open V-notch, giving a contrast outline against the mid-grey body. Sleeve ends and lower body finish in narrow ribbed bands, with a deeper ribbed hem band at the bottom edge.

Sheer corded-lace blouse constructed with a dense floral-lace ground carried across the whole body and sleeves, with the open lace mesh letting skin and an inner garment read through across the torso. A single centre-front column of spaced round buttons runs the full length of the front. The long sleeves finish in a widening bell at the wrist, ending in a scalloped, picot/eyelash lace edge; the same scalloped edge finishes the lower hem. The neckline is a plain rounded crew with no collar. The body reads as softly shaped to the torso with slight puff at the sleeve head.

Floor-length column gown in matte black jersey-like cloth with a high mock neck. The yoke across the upper chest and shoulders is sheer net carrying a dense black floral lace appliqué that reads as leaves and blossoms, climbing to the neck band and over the cap-sleeve shoulders; below this illusion yoke a deep V of the same lace plunges toward the solid bodice, so the central chest reads as sheer net filled with lace rather than bare skin. The solid opaque body begins at the bust and runs uninterrupted as a close column down past the hips, the cloth skimming the figure before releasing into a slight widening sweep at the floor-length hem.

Floor-length column gown in matte black jersey-type cloth, cut with a bateau/boat neckline that runs high and wide across the collarbones. The defining feature is a yoke of sheer illusion mesh across the upper chest and shoulders, divided into three horizontal bands by two solid self-fabric stripes that curve parallel to the neckline, so the solid bodice begins below the bust while skin reads through the sheer bands above. Short set-in sleeves are solid self-fabric. The torso carries horizontal shirring/ruching gathered toward one side at the waist, softly defining it, and the skirt falls straight and narrow to the floor.

Bias-cut slip dress in a fluid silver satin that catches light along its draped folds; the body falls close over the hips then widens gently toward the lower hem, reading as a bias-draped column rather than a seamed A-line. The front is held by two very fine spaghetti straps that cross the shoulders into a narrow V-front, with the satin falling in a soft inverted-V drape from the bust seam. No visible closure or seam detailing interrupts the smooth body front.
